methods.name: Early quests
methods.note: Goblin generals subquest and Fairytale I reach 20, The Garden of Death reaches 30. The full list gives 32,500 XP, level 38.

methods.name: Herb runs
methods.note: Up to 10 patches, 5 to 10 minutes a run. Always use ultracompost and magic secateurs. Figures assume 9 patches and 8 herbs each.

methods.name: Tree runs
methods.note: Check health, pay 200 coins to clear, replant. Six patches, a seventh in the Farming Guild at 65. Oak grows in 200 min, magic in 480.

methods.name: Fruit tree runs
methods.note: Five patches, plus Lletya and the Farming Guild at 85. Every fruit tree takes 16 hours. Cheaper per XP than regular trees.

methods.name: Coral nurseries
methods.note: Two underwater nurseries off The Great Conch. Elkhorn at 28, pillar at 52, umbral at 77. Small XP, grown for potion ingredients.

methods.name: Tithe Farm
methods.note: Hosidius minigame that needs no seeds of your own. Unlocks the farmer's outfit, seed box, herb sack and auto-weed.

methods.name: Hardwood tree runs
methods.note: Three patches on Fossil Island, one in Varlamore, one on Anglers' Retreat. Teak takes 74 h 40 min, mahogany and up 85 h 20 min.

methods.name: Hespori
methods.note: Farming Guild boss patch. Plant a Hespori seed and kill it 32 hours later for 12,600 XP plus anima and white lily seeds.

methods.name: Calquat trees
methods.note: Three patches: Tai Bwo Wannai, Kastori and The Summer Shore. Payment is 8 poison ivy berries. Done as part of the tree run.

methods.name: Crystal tree
methods.note: Prifddinas patch that cannot die. Grows in 8 hours and yields about 30 crystal shards with ultracompost.

methods.name: Celastrus tree
methods.note: Farming Guild patch. Harvest the bark for profit or pay to clear it. Payment is 8 potato cactus. Grows in 13 h 20 min.

methods.name: Redwood tree
methods.note: Farming Guild patch. Takes 106 h 40 min to grow and 2,000 coins to clear. Payment is 6 dragonfruit.

unverified: Early quests: one-off quest XP, no hourly rate; the main guide's list totals 32,500 XP (level 38), the Ironman Guide's totals 27,500 (level 37); no rate is given for bagged plants, compost, allotments or Sorceress's Garden at 1 to 15

Tree, fruit tree, hardwood, calquat, crystal, celastrus and redwood xph are DERIVED, not stated: the guide's only timing is 14 patches in 5 min 20 s (about 2,400,000 an hour for 6 magic, 6 dragonfruit, calquat, celastrus), so 22.9 s per patch, 157.5 patches per active hour, times each sapling's total XP with protection payment

Tree runs: per and every are for oak (6 patches x 481.3, 200 min). Per run at 6 patches: willow 8,889 every 240 min, maple 20,690 every 320, yew 42,905 every 400, magic 83,483 every 480. Six patches follows the guide's example run, which includes the Varlamore patch

Fruit tree runs: per is for apple at 5 patches (guide's low-level example, includes Kastori); per run at 5 patches: banana 9,208, orange 12,934, curry 15,185, pineapple 23,959, papaya 31,902, palm 52,548, dragonfruit 89,125; XP includes picking 6 fruit; every is 960 min for all

Hardwood tree runs: per is teak at 5 patches (3 need Bone Voyage, 1 needs The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute, 1 needs 51 Sailing); per run at 5 patches: mahogany 78,915, camphor 89,640, ironwood 102,625 (all every 5,120 min), rosewood 116,760 (every 6,400 min)

Herb runs: xph is DERIVED from the Farming runs page (herb-only run takes five to ten minutes, 10 seeds for all patches), so 7.5 min per 10 patches, 80 patches per active hour, times XP per patch assuming 8 herbs (Herb patch/Seeds); per is guam at 9 patches (the Farming Guild patch needs 65); goutweed skipped
Tithe Farm: the guide only gives 90,000 to 100,000 from level 74; the 34 and 54 figures are scaled by fruit XP (6, 14, 23 per fruit, from the Tithe Farm page) and are not stated anywhere

Coral nurseries: not in either guide; no XP rate or run time on the Coral nursery (patch) page; per assumes 2 nurseries at the minimum yield of 4 elkhorn (pillar 585, umbral 1,544); growth is 4 x 40 min
Hespori: no kill time is given, so no xph; per is 62 planting plus 12,600 on kill
Calquat trees: 3 patches assumed (Kastori needs Varlamore access, The Summer Shore needs Troubled Tortugans partly done)
Farming contracts: neither guide nor the Farming contracts page gives an XP rate, so no method was added
The guide's own example run total (215,761.3 XP) does not match the sum of its table values (217,353.8)
